mapper.select: select fou.* from fnd_org_unit fou, fnd_company fc where fou.company_id = fc.company_id and fc.company_code = #{companyCode}

select u.unit_id, u.unit_code, u.unit_name, mgr_a.employee_id as mgrEmployeeId, mgr_a.employee_name as mgrEmployeeName from fnd_org_unit u, () mgr_a
mgr_a.position_id = u.chief_position_id
AND u.unit_id = ( select unit_id from hls_lease_org_assign t2 where t2.lease_organization=#{leaseOrganization} and t2.unit_id=u.unit_id )
